about: Field cases, written once from FieldFinderTest.kt by recording each FieldFinder call it made, with the screen it was given and what it found (openspec: add-browser-extension, task 7.1). Never regenerate: FieldFinder.kt and the extension's src/content/fields.ts must each find what every case expects. A screen is a tree of Android FieldNodes; the extension reads a web field from the same node. A case marked androidOnly relies on what only Android has (apps' autofill hints, Chrome's predictions, or frames of other sites in one screen), and the extension skips it.
